text:
sara-partnerships: Heads-up — received updated from vendor this morning. ETA for the next 96-card shipment slipped by 3 weeks due to a port congestion reroute. This affects reserved pools for Apr-June commits.
akash: ugh. which reservations are impacted? can you paste the reservation IDs?
sara-partnerships: main ones are: `RESV-7391`, `RESV-7400`, and the cross-marketplace promo batch `MP-APR-21` (the one tied to GCP marketplace credits). vendor said containers delayed at origin, expected rebook window 2/27->3/1.
maria-logistics: confirmed, carrier updated our booking. ETA shift is real. Freight manifest shows `ETA: 2027-04-12` -> `2027-05-03` for the bulk pallet.
oliver: what does this do to our Dedicated pool capacity? Any risk to customer SLAs?
akash: short answer: yes for a handful of Dedicated customers on small reserved GPU plans (8-32 cards). We can cover burst for 2 weeks using on-demand spot from partner accounts, but prolonged >3 weeks will require rebalancing.
jess-sales: we have 3 active proposals hinging on Apr availability (2 enterprise POCs). If delivery shifts past their go-live, we need to notify and offer interim Hosted credit or temporary Dedicated on other regions. Do we have a recommended message?
sara-partnerships: draft communication: "We're monitoring a shipping delay from our hardware partner that may impact reserved capacity timelines. We'll provide mitigations (temporary capacity re-route, marketplace credit) and a firm updated ETA by Mar 4." Thoughts?
akash: add concrete mitigations: 1) temporary routing to eu-west-2 pool (if latency ok) 2) free Hosted credits for impacted customers 3) priority rebuild when inventory arrives.
maria-logistics: also flag customs clearance could add 48-72h if arrival window tight. Recommend we avoid promising exact day until container actually unloads.
oliver: technical note: if we need to route Dedicated workloads to eu-west-2, model kernel selection differs for A100 vs H100; run a quick smoke on staging for the 1.5k token workloads. I can schedule a 30-min canary test.
akash: please coordinate with eng-runtime for the canary. @oliver can you add the test plan as a gist? We'll need to update autoscaler policies to avoid preemptive scale-down during migration.
jess-sales: I'll hold off customer comms until we have mitigation options listed. If we offer Marketplace credit, need exact SKU mapping and how credit is applied (marketplace coupon vs Redwood credit).
sara-partnerships: vendor also indicated one pallet (about 12 cards) is being rerouted to a different port and will arrive earlier — could offset some capacity churn. Not reliable yet but possible.
shipment-bot: Container update: container XYZ-9345 status changed to "rebooked" at 2027-02-24T09:12Z. Next ETA window: 2027-05-01 to 2027-05-04.
maria-logistics: action items: (1) I will request prioritization for `RESV-7391` and escalate to partner ops; (2) prep customs fast-track docs; (3) confirm which pallet is rerouted and get manifest.
akash: action items from infra: (a) prepare temporary region routing playbook, (b) autoscaler tweak PR in progress, (c) list affected customers+impact window. I'll tag eng-runtime.
oliver: I'll schedule the canary tests for tomorrow 09:30 PT and post results here.
jess-sales: I'll draft two comm templates: urgent ETA shift + mitigation offer, and status follow-up when we have firm dates.
sara-partnerships: thanks all. if the early pallet pans out we might avoid outreach for 2 customers. Will update by Mar 4 w/ partner's confirmed manifest. :pray:
